spec.title: Global Error Budget Burn Rate (1 = consuming at allowed rate)

spec.description: Critical endpoints passing SLO / Total critical endpoints
spec.title: Critical SLOs Passing

spec.description: Error budget remaining for the selected time range (based on 99.95% SLO target)
spec.title: Error Budget Remaining

spec.expr:
(
  (100 * (1 - (
    sum by (endpoint, method) (rate(polar_http_request_total{env="$env", status_code=~"5.."}[$__range]))
    or (sum by (endpoint, method) (rate(polar_http_request_total{env="$env"}[$__range])) * 0)
  ) / sum by (endpoint, method) (rate(polar_http_request_total{env="$env"}[$__range]))))
  < on(endpoint, method) group_left() max by (endpoint, method) (last_over_time(polar_slo_availability_target{env="$env"}[1h]))
)

spec.description: Endpoints currently breaching their SLO targets. Empty means all healthy!
spec.title: Breaching SLOs (Critical Endpoints)

spec.expr:
(
  (sum by (endpoint, method) (rate(polar_http_request_total{env="$env", status_code=~"5.."}[1h])) or vector(0))
  /
  ((1 - max by (endpoint, method) (last_over_time(polar_slo_availability_target{env="$env"}[1h])) / 100) * sum by (endpoint, method) (rate(polar_http_request_total{env="$env"}[1h])))
)

spec.description: Error budget burn rate for critical endpoints. Values >1 indicate faster than sustainable consumption.
spec.title: Critical Endpoints Burn Rate (1h window)

spec.description: Resolved API version for routed requests. Requests without Polar-Version use Current. Rejected versions and existing metric exclusions are not counted.
spec.title: Request Rate by API Version

spec.expr: 100 * (1 - (sum by (endpoint, method) (increase(polar_http_request_total{env="$env", status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or (sum by (endpoint, method) (increase(polar_http_request_total{env="$env"}[$__range])) * 0)) / clamp_min(sum by (endpoint, method) (increase(polar_http_request_total{env="$env"}[$__range])), 1))

100 * (1 - (sum(rate(polar_http_request_total{env="$env", endpoint=~"$endpoint", method=~"$method", status_code=~"5.."}[5m])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(polar_http_request_total{env="$env", endpoint=~"$endpoint", method=~"$method"}[5m])))
